description: This file contains the implementation of the NewtonsoftJsonCodec class for JSON serialization/deserialization using Newtonsoft.Json, along with options configuration and extension methods for serializer registration within the Orleans framework. It appears to be an auto-generated partial class that provides serialization support via JSON for the Orleans system.
